sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Kanazawa Gold Bento region of the map, Kanazawa: a famous strolling garden with ponds and pines held up by cone-shaped snow ropes, samurai houses and gold leaf. Region colours: banner #C9A227 to #8C6D0F, land #CFE0B0.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: neat garden lawn in #CFE0B0.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a round flat stepping stone.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a round flat stepping stone.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 opaque PNG with four exact equal logical quadrants, no drawn borders, grid lines or gutters. Straight top-down flat 2D ground. Uniform neat pale green garden lawn #CFE0B0 in left-column cells and about 12% lighter #E1ECCD in right-column cells. A few sparse short curved grass tufts in different positions in each cell. Each lower cell has exactly ONE small round flat grey stepping stone, seen from directly above, with a crisp dark-brown outline and one hard-edged shadow tone, placed differently. All markings and stones remain at least 12% away from quadrant edges. Border regions must be uninterrupted flat solid lawn for seamless repetition. No water, paths, buildings, trees, flowers, extra rocks, gradients, texture noise, realistic grass, vignette or edge shading.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Top-down three-quarter view, seen from above at about 45 degrees, each object sitting on an invisible ground with its base near the bottom of its cell. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Standalone items are centred with about 10% empty margin. Everything outside the items is fully transparent.

Deco tiles:
f1 (top-left) mountain: a moss hill with a waterfall (not on this band today).
f2 (top-right) forest: a pine tree with yukitsuri ropes fanning down from a tall pole in a cone.
f3 (bottom-left) city: a samurai house behind an earthen wall with a gold-leaf trim.
f4 (bottom-right) special: a two-legged kotoji stone lantern by a little pond.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 transparent PNG atlas with four EXACT logical quadrants of equal size. Each COMPLETE prop fits within a centered 320x320 area inside its own 512x512 quadrant with generous transparent padding. Top-left: ONE rounded moss-covered hill with a small waterfall cascading into a compact pool at its base. Top-right: ONE rounded Japanese pine held by yukitsuri snow-support ropes, a tall central wooden pole with several clearly separated tan ropes fanning out in a conical shape to the outer branches. Entire pole and rope cone visible and inside the quadrant. Bottom-left: ONE compact samurai house behind a low ochre earthen wall with a narrow gold-leaf trim, black-grey roof. Bottom-right: ONE two-legged grey kotoji stone lantern next to a small oval pond, lantern supported by exactly TWO splayed stone legs, one rooted on the bank and the other at the water's edge. View from above at about 45 degrees. Chunky rounded chibi shapes, thick dark-brown outlines #4A2A1A, flat cel colors with one hard shadow tone. Real transparent alpha outside props and through openings, no common land or background. No cross-cell overlap, cropped poles or clipped silhouettes. No text, labels, people, gradients, photoreal texture or shadow haze.

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Kanazawa transparent 2x2 decoration atlas. Preserve ALL FOUR existing designs, palettes, thick dark-brown outlines, cel shading and transparent alpha: top-left moss waterfall hill; top-right pine with cone-shaped yukitsuri ropes and tall pole; bottom-left samurai house behind gold-trimmed earthen wall; bottom-right exactly two-legged stone lantern by a pond. Change ONLY object sizes and placement: uniformly shrink EACH complete prop to 70% of its current size and recenter it in its original logical quadrant. Each quadrant is 512x512 in the final square 1024x1024 image, and each complete prop MUST fit inside the central 360x360 area, at least 76px from ALL four quadrant edges. Keep complete outlines, no clipped pole, branches, walls, water or rocks. No overlap across quadrant seams. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the props and through existing gaps. No new objects, text, backgrounds or labels. This must be a 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
